lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple rows of high-luminance, circular pixel clusters are visible posterior to the gill slits, forming a grid-like spatial arrangement with approximately uniform spacing between adjacent centroids.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two continuous horizontal features exhibit a sharp vertical intensity gradient (light-to-shadow transition) across the upper lateral flank, indicating defined structural ridges.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin surface displays a dense, randomized distribution of smaller high-luminance spots compared to the lateral flank; a separate, elongated low-luminance silhouette is visible ventrally to the pectoral fin.
